Build several "Ideas"-stage enhancements for the Nxeon Cold Email Engine module. Work EXCLUSIVELY in /opt/nxeon-wt-ceideas (branch feature/ceideas). node_modules symlinked. Do NOT run build/prisma commands — code only.

CONTEXT: The Cold Email Engine is a built-but-gated Nxeon admin module (lib/coldemail/*, worker/coldemail*.ts, app/admin/coldemail/*). SENDING IS HARD-GATED OFF (cold_email_sending_enabled defaults false) and MUST STAY OFF — do not change that; these are infrastructure/compliance features that make the engine safer/better BEFORE sending is ever turned on. STUDY lib/coldemail/ (compliance.ts, sender.ts, the schema models for Brand/SendingIdentity/Campaign/Contact/Suppression/etc.) first.

Build these Ideas-column features (all within the CE module, all compliance-positive):
1. **Cross-brand frequency cap** — a single contact must not be emailed by MULTIPLE brands within a window (e.g. no more than 1 email per contact per N days across ALL brands). Add the cap to the send-eligibility gate (evaluateSendEligibility / compliance.ts) keyed on the contact's normalized email across brands, with an admin-configurable window. This prevents over-mailing a person via different brands.
2. **Complaint-rate circuit breaker** — automatically PAUSE a brand/campaign's sending when its complaint (or bounce) rate over a rolling window exceeds a threshold (e.g. >0.3% complaints). Add a worker check (in the deliverability sweep) that flips a brand/campaign to a PAUSED/CIRCUIT_OPEN state + alerts the operator; require manual re-enable. This protects domain reputation.
3. **AI personalization tokens (opt-in)** — let a template opt into AI-generated personalization tokens (e.g. a one-line personalized opener from the prospect's business info) using the existing Claude helper (askClaude, model claude-opus-4-8) — generated at render time, cached per contact, opt-in per template, and passing the existing template lint / CAN-SPAM checks. Never fabricate facts about the prospect; keep it to neutral, verifiable business context. 
4. **Deliverability/warmup dashboard** — an admin page (app/admin/coldemail/warming or extend it) showing per-sending-domain warmup status, reputation signals, daily send caps + ramp, SPF/DKIM/DMARC auth status, and bounce/complaint trends. Read from the existing warmup/deliverability data (worker/coldemail-deliverability.ts) — a real dashboard over data that already exists.
(Skip "Places local-vertical discovery" if time is short — flag it as deferred.)

Keep sending OFF; these are guardrails + tooling. DELIVER, then commit `git add -A && git commit -m "feat(coldemail): cross-brand freq cap, complaint circuit breaker, AI personalization tokens, warmup dashboard"` (trailer Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>), `git push -u origin feature/ceideas`. REPORT (factual): each feature, where it hooks into the compliance/send gate, schema added, and confirm sending stays gated OFF. Don't claim tested.
